game_concept: A speed quiz set in Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones, standing whisper stones: the scholar mage must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones: standing whisper stones
core_gameplay_loop: In Whisper Stones, repeat each round: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group. Each round, a new carved tiles challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the slice_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 380 points of carved tiles by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 380, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 8 (extended tier): Slice Slicer
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Whisper Stones'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slice_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Whisper Stones.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 380 within 51 seconds.
